content: {"episode_id":"ep-05002","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for a patient presenting with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.91) in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73, G45.9). Extended ambulatory monitoring is necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity in order to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies. The clinical indication note in the submitted records supports the medical necessity of this diagnostic study for this patient."}
